answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network uses topological cut verifications across interaction graphs. Independent auditing nodes stake capital to challenge clustered cliques. Disproving a deceptive fable is crystal clear under this game design: honest verifiers receive violet bounty tokens, while Sybil clusters lose their bond exponentially with size.
